text:
sara_cs: Heads up — Acme reported a month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows ~$820 for Feb, invoice charged $1,250 (INV-2026-0228). They also say plan tier on the invoice is 'Business' not 'Startup'. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/acme/inv-0228.png :eyes:

maria_support: Account ID? Any customer-provided breakdown?

sara_cs: acct_9x2. Customer attached CSV of dashboard export and PDF invoice. Says line items differ: dashboard tokens column sums ~3.4M tokens; invoice line items show 5.2M tokens.

alex_billing: Putting on billing queue. Two quick things to check: 1) reserved/dedicated capacity — any committed usage we might be charging? 2) proration or multi-currency rounding at month boundaries.

tom_infra: I can check raw ingest events. Can you share invoice id + account id (have them). I'll run a token-sum query over the billing window.

sara_cs: Sent the files in the thread DM.

tom_infra: Ran quick query against ingestion table (UTC month window 2026-02-01 00:00:00 -> 2026-02-28 23:59:59). Found a late retry burst on 2026-02-28 23:54 UTC that shows duplicated request_ids in the billing pipeline for endpoint /generate-chat. Rough output:```sql
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hr, sum(tokens) FROM billing_events
WHERE account_id='acct_9x2' AND ts >= '2026-02-01' AND ts < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 6;
-- last hour: 2026-02-28T23:00  tokens=2,050,432
```

alex_billing: 2M tokens in the last hour would explain the delta. Why did dashboard only show ~600k for that hour?

tom_infra: Dashboard query aggregates token counts after dedupe by request_id at a later stage; billing pipeline picks up events earlier (pre-dedupe) for certain endpoints when the legacy retrier injected cloned events. Looks like one of the retrier paths wrote two events with different event_ids but same payload, and our billing ETL didn't dedupe on content.

maria_support: So dashboard is deduped but invoice uses raw billing events -> double-count. Is that always the case or just this customer/endpoint?

tom_infra: It's a class of cases — rare, but triggered when client retry + our old ingress retrier both fired. Mostly seen on high-concurrency endpoints. We have a patch in staging to dedupe earlier.

alex_billing: For this invoice we should: 1) issue a credit for the duplicated tokens, 2) update invoice line item notes, 3) run a sweep to detect other affected invoices for Feb. I can take point on the credit.

sara_cs: Customer wants an ETA and a corrected invoice. They flagged impact to their reconciliation.

alex_billing: I'll open a billing ticket and create a credit memo. Internal ticket: BILL-7541. ETA: credit applied within 48hrs, corrected invoice in next billing cycle unless they want immediate reissued copy.

billing-bot: [auto] Created invoice adjustment draft BILL-7541 by alex_billing.

maria_support: For transparency, can we include a short explanation in the credit memo: duplicated billing events caused by retrier path -> non-deduped billing ETL.

alex_billing: Yes, I'll include that wording and attach the query results. Also note: the 'Business' tier on the invoice — I verified.plan_id on the invoice was plan_business_2026; customer should have been billed for plan_startup_annual. Looks like plan change event processed on 2026-03-01 but invoice date is 2026-02-28; need to confirm plan assignment at invoice run.

tom_infra: Plan mismatch might be because the subscription service write for acct_9x2 was delayed and our invoice generation job picked up the old plan id. I'll check subscription history.

tom_infra: Quick check shows a subscription update event for acct_9x2 with effective_date=2026-03-01T00:05Z, but invoice job used system local date (America/Los_Angeles) for cutover. Cross-timezone boundary means invoice generator saw the upgrade earlier than dashboard.

sara_cs: So two issues: duplicate token counts + plan cutover timezone mismatch. Yikes.

alex_billing: We'll: (A) credit duplicated tokens, (B) re-run invoice generator with corrected tz logic for affected customers and reissue corrected invoice, (C) escalate fix to billing ETL & subscription service.

maria_support: Action items and owners?

sara_cs: Customer-facing note: I'll send a templated apology + expected timeline once credit is queued.

tom_infra: Tech fixes: dedupe in billing ETL (PR #1179), and change invoice generator to use subscription effective_date in UTC (PR #1181). I'll link both PRs to BILL-7541.

alex_billing: I'll confirm once credit posted. Also will add a one-off audit of Feb invoices for accounts with >1M tokens in last day.

sara_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll update Acme with the credit ETA and that we're reissuing. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: Noting postmortem required. Tagging eng-sre for follow-up. :memo:

sara_cs: Closing loop here once credit posted.
